# Metrics / Validation Evidence

**Recorded Canton DevNet runs demonstrate the core trading, privacy, settlement, and refund flow.**

## Recorded technical evidence

| Run | What it demonstrated |
| --- | --- |
| **First call · 6 Oct** | Firm quote, acceptance, owner and outsider reads, oracle attestations, resolution, and settlement. |
| **Refund paths · 6 Oct** | Void refunds and a stale refund while venue operations were stopped. |
| **Coin rail · 7 Oct** | A DevNet Canton Coin deposit and withdrawal round trip. |
| **Four-hour operations run · 6 Oct** | 168 windows opened, 129 resolved, 35 voided, and zero ledger rejections. Network interruptions and failures are retained in the records. |

## What we measure next

Our primary product metric will be **users completing a first trade through settlement or refund**.

- **Completion:** how many testers finish the core flow after starting it.
- **Repeat use:** how many return for another market.
- **Feedback:** where quote, wallet, proof, or mobile onboarding needs improvement.

External user-demand validation is still in progress. Interview, retention, and paying-user results have not been established.
